title: The Ass in the Lion’s Skin
originalTitle: Greek title not preserved in this edition
sourceAuthor: Aesop; selected and retold by Joseph Jacobs

artLabel: An ass wearing a lion skin proudly enters a frightened village.

pageArt.alt: The disguised Ass opens his mouth and brays as the villagers turn to look.
A knowing Fox recognizes the Ass beneath the loose lion skin.

scenes: An Ass once found a Lion’s skin which the hunters had left out in the sun to dry. He put it on and went towards his native village.

All fled at his approach, both men and animals, and he was a proud Ass that day. In his delight he lifted up his voice and brayed, but then every one knew him, and his owner came up and gave him a sound cudgelling for the fright he had caused.
And shortly afterwards a Fox came up to him and said: “Ah, I knew you by your voice.”
Fine clothes may disguise, but silly words will disclose a fool.
